headline: Russia Launches Massive Overnight Strike on Ukraine, Houthis Target Riyadh
subheadline: Saudi air defenses intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles launched from Yemen toward Riyadh, while IDF conducted intensive southern Lebanon operations.
lede: Russia launched one of its largest combined attacks, firing approximately 80 cruise missiles, up to 20 ballistic missiles, and around 400 drones targeting energy infrastructure, bridges, and enterprises across Ukraine, with strikes reported in Kyiv, Lviv, and western regions. Ukrainian air defenses claimed 94% interception of cruise missiles and 83% of Shahed drones, while two Russian Kh-101 missiles and a Shahed drone violated Polish airspace. Saudi Arabia intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh, and FT reports hawkish U.S. and Israeli officials urging Trump to resume strikes on Iran before year-end.

sections.title: Russia's Massive Overnight Attack Across Ukraine
sections.body: Russia launched approximately 80 cruise missiles, up to 20 ballistic missiles, and around 400 drones targeting energy infrastructure, bridges, and enterprises across Ukraine, with strikes reported in Kyiv, Lviv, and western regions. Ukrainian air defenses claimed 94% interception of cruise missiles and 83% of Shahed drones. Russian strikes hit Lviv's Sknylyv railway station, killing two and injuring at least four civilians, and Ukrainian forces struck three Russian ballistic missile launchers and attacked the Dorogobuzh explosives plant in Russia. Two Russian Kh-101 missiles and a Shahed drone violated Polish airspace.

sections.title: Gulf Escalation as Houthis Target Riyadh
sections.body: Saudi Arabia intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh, marking a significant Gulf escalation. Israeli officials and U.S. hawks are pressing Trump to resume strikes on Iran before year-end amid concerns over military readiness erosion. The IDF maintains full readiness with no changes to public guidelines while conducting intensive operations across southern Lebanon, and Israel upgraded David's Sling air defense system range to intercept missiles and UAVs while reducing reliance on expensive interceptors. Daily Lebanon report noted 144 alerts including 87 drone sightings and 21 artillery strikes, concentrated in Nabatieh and South districts.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous Saudi interception of Houthi ballistic missiles and Israeli-U.S. pressure for renewed Iran strikes indicates a region-wide escalation trajectory. Iran's air defense activations across Isfahan and Khuzestan suggest heightened alert posture, while Israel's David's Sling upgrade and intensive Lebanon operations demonstrate multi-front readiness. The convergence of these developments within a single reporting cycle suggests the conflict is entering a more volatile phase with reduced decision time for all actors.
